title: The Rope across the Stream
story: Nia and her uncle followed red markers up the valley. The path ended at a fast stream. A rope was tied between two trees for walkers to hold. Nia tested the first stone with her boot. It felt firm. She crossed slowly, one hand on the rope, and kept her eyes on the far bank. Her uncle came next with the packs. Halfway across he slipped, but the rope held him. They reached a dry rock and laughed with relief. On the other side the markers led into pine trees. Nia checked the map and saw the hut was close. They walked on before the light faded.
